scope: Saved paired3primary cycles;42 boundaryFK poses plus arithmetic on previously saved contact integrals. No integration, dynamics realization, IK solving, tuning, input or plugin changes.

findings.claim: Pelvis vertical reserves externally compensate the gross online contact impulse difference. Whole-body COM endpoint momentum accounts for less than2Ns; saved forces including reserves close the vertical momentum budget within0.066Ns.

In these own-subject reference comparisons, the healthy-to-virtual mass/COM/reference convention changes the integrated no-support left-force demand by less than0.6Ns. This cannot explain the observed hundreds-of-Ns surplus/deficit as a reference vertical-momentum demand.
Dividing both simulated and measured left impulse by the same BW leaves their ratio unchanged. BW normalization cannot create the within-subject impulse percentage difference.

A common scalar contact amplitude fitted on the first AB06 cycle approximately preserves later AB06 impulses but increases the AB07 error. A single common amplitude error is insufficient on these saved trajectories.

Experimental left GRF is from the original healthy experiment, whereas the left runtime load is generated by a virtual prosthesis with an AB06-calibrated sparse contact basis. Comparison is a benchmark reference, not a paired experimental hardware validation.

A pose-force replay changes no mass or recruitment directly. Anatomy enters through body/foot kinematics; own-model/own-IK comparisons combine anatomy, mounting, marker calibration and gait. The complementary model×motion/geometric-preparation factorial is needed to separate their direct contact contributions.

limits: The COM exclusion applies to integrated primary-cycle momentum, not force waveform, transient accelerations or indirect mass/inertia effects on dynamically attained tracking.
Healthy/originalIK versus virtual/preparedIK is a combined comparison; it does not isolate a mass-only intervention. Potential opposing internal effects are not decomposed.
The common-amplitude check is post-hoc and freezes trajectories. It is not prospective external validation or an estimate of the resulting dynamics after stiffness changes.
Vertical force balance does not separately validate measured moments/COP or their indirect effect on motion; it verifies the dominant integrated external vertical-force accounting.
AB06 failed original terminal callback remains failed; no endpoint observation/reward/FSM data were reconstructed. Only fully supported preselected primary physical data are used.
